title: Release cutover checklist — 2026-03-04 (Aisha scratchpad)
content:
Context:
- Daily scratchpad for the 2026-03-04 release cutover (minor runtime patch, backport to 2.1.x).
- This is my working checklist. Will sync with Jordan + Samira 09:30 PT standup.

Pre-cutover (Before 09:45 PT)
- [ ] Confirm approval from infra on rollout window (Samira confirmed 03-03, re-check).
- [ ] Verify on-call rota and escalation path: SRE on-call = Diego, Release lead = Jordan. PD runbook link pasted to #releases.
- [ ] Block traffic to canary region in feature-flagging dashboard (feature: runtime-2.1.3-canary).
- [ ] Ensure snapshots/backups created for affected services: model-cache, kv-store snapshots. Commands:
    - snapshot-kv --env=prod --tag=pre-cutover-20260304
    - aws s3 cp /var/backups/model-cache s3://redwood-backups/release-2026-03-04/
- [ ] Post cutover channel created: #release-cutover-2026-03-04 (already created).

Release steps (09:45–10:30 PT)
- Canary rollout (09:45):
    - [ ] Deploy runtime image: gcr.io/redwood/runtime:2.1.3-patch
    - [ ] Run smoke tests (smoke/run_smoke_suite.sh) against canary for 10 minutes.
    - [ ] Check latency/5xx: dashboard -> per-route latency; threshold: p95 < 1200ms, 5xx < 0.5%.
- [ ] If smoke passes, trigger gradual roll to 10% traffic (routing service). Command: routingctl promote --target=10 --tag=2.1.3-patch
- [ ] Monitor metrics for 30m at 10% (consumer QPS sample). Accept/abort decision at 10:30.
- [ ] On accept, continue roll to 50% then 100% with 15m observation windows.

Backports / Hotfix list
- Backport PRs that must be included in 2.1.x:
    - PR 1409: fix-kv-cache-leak (cherry-pick to release/2.1.x)
    - PR 1418: guard-rail-for-oom (cherry-pick)
    - PR 1423: kernel-fallback (already merged to main, needs backport)
- [ ] Confirm CI green for each backport branch: run ./ci/run_unit_and_integration.sh --branch release/2.1.x-patch
- [ ] Tag artifacts and upload to internal registry: internal-registry/redwood/runtime:2.1.3-patch

Comms (pre + during + post)
- Pre: email to product + support (T-30m) with expected impact (none for user-facing; backend-only restart). Template saved in Confluence linked_artifacts.
- During: post status updates every 15m to #release-cutover-2026-03-04. Standard format: [TIME] Step / status / metrics / action
- Post: update release notes, close JIRA ticket (JIRA-RELEASE-3210), notify stakeholders in #eng-all.

Rollback plan (if we hit regression)
- Trigger: p95 latency > 1500ms sustained for 10m OR 5xx > 1% for 5m.
- Steps:
    - [ ] routingctl rollback --tag=2.1.3-patch (instant rollback to previous image)
    - [ ] If rollback fails, scale down new pods and scale up stable pods: k scale deploy/runtime --replicas=0 --selector=tag=2.1.3-patch; k scale deploy/runtime --replicas=20 --selector=tag=2.1.2-stable
    - [ ] Open incident in PagerDuty, notify manager and product.

Post-cutover (within 2 hours)
- [ ] Run full integration test suite: ./ci/run_full_integration.sh --env=prod
- [ ] Collect perf snapshots and save to S3: s3://redwood-metrics/release-2026-03-04/
- [ ] Update rolling logs: add note to Confluence release page that manual QA passed.
- [ ] Schedule follow-up retro if any incidents: add agenda to #release-retros 

Notes / gotchas (things to watch)
- KV-cache eviction threshold change in this patch — watch cache hit-rate closely.
- Model-serving cold-start for rare model variant: may spike p95 for a short window. Consider extra observation for endpoints: /v1/generate-large.
- Keep an eye on Dedicated customers (customer IDs: CUST-1012, CUST-1108) — they require calendar notice; customer-success already messaged.

Questions / TODO for follow-up
- Should we also promote quantized build in the same window or keep separate? (leaning separate; avoid coupling).
- Confirm that logging level for runtime in prod remains INFO — not changed by PR 1423.

Quick command snippets (copy-paste)
- Promote rollout 10%: routingctl promote --target=10 --tag=2.1.3-patch
- Rollback: routingctl rollback --tag=2.1.3-patch
- Snapshot kv: snapshot-kv --env=prod --tag=pre-cutover-20260304

Notes to self:
- Keep updates short and structured in the Slack channel.
- If anything looks off, don’t hesitate to abort the roll and escalate (better to pause).

----
Appendix (links):
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-RELEASE-2026-03
- JIRA: JIRA-RELEASE-3210
- PRs: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1409, /pull/1418, /pull/1423

End of scratchpad.
